description: A banned identifier (e.g., 'webhook') with a zero-width space inserted between characters to evade pattern matching: 'we​b​hook'. The sanitizer strips the zero-width character first, then the ban-pattern scan sees the full identifier and blocks it. This tests that stripping happens before scanning (ADR-075 decision 5).
raw_text: Our integration uses the we​b​hook endpoint for notifications.
provenance: ADR-075 decision 5 hidden-text stripping before ban-pattern scan; #1218 regression test.
